title: Oozy Japanese Form Inari
description: Resinous, bouncy-qq, cozy Japanese dish featuring apple cider vinegar, stir-fry, and form=inarizushi. Fodmap-friendly and perfect for a quick dinner or snack.
instructions: Rinse the short-grain Japanese rice in a fine-mesh strainer under cold running water until the water runs clear.
Combine the rice and water in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender.
While the rice is cooking, whisk together the apple cider vinegar, gochujang, and sesame oil in a small bowl until smooth.
When the rice is done, fluff it with a fork and stir in the vinegar mixture, toasted sesame seeds, and salt to taste.
Cut the cucumber into thin slices and set aside.
Cut the pickled ginger into thin slices and set aside.
Tear the shiso leaves into small pieces and set aside.
In a small bowl, combine the cooked rice, cucumber, pickled ginger, and shiso leaves.
Garnish with additional shiso leaves and serve warm or at room temperature.
